title: Monotonicity of halting-output probability
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output, let $x$ and $v$ be Boolean words, and let $t,t'$ be natural numbers with $t\le t'$. The probability that a uniformly random choice word of length $t$ makes the machine halt with output $v$ is at most the corresponding probability for choice words of length $t'$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output
